```html
<form hx-post="..." hx-target="#hike-rows" hx-swap="afterbegin" ...>
<tbody id="hike-rows">
```

The form targeted the whole `#hike-table` with `outerHTML`, so htmx replaced the entire table with the single `<tr>` your view returns. Now it targets the `<tbody>` and inserts the new row at the top (`afterbegin`, matching your `-date` ordering). The 422 error partial will also land in the tbody now; if you want errors next to the form, set `hx-target-422` with the response-targets extension or use `HX-Retarget` in the view. # @acme/cli

Internal command-line tool for Acme.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g @acme/cli
```

## Usage

### acme invoices list

List invoices for the current org.

```sh
acme invoices list [--status <status>] [--limit <n>] [--json]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--status` | all | Filter by draft, sent, paid, overdue or void |
| `--limit` | 25 | Max rows (1-100) |
| `--json` | false | Print JSON instead of a table |
